nodes.reason: Fear of punishment is the lower tier of holy fear. Its essential nature is יִרְאָה (fear/awe of God) — specifically the entry-level fear that initiates the spiritual path. The teaching equates it with צֶדֶק (justice) via נִקְרָא, placing it squarely in the domain of holy fear.

Faith is the higher tier of holy fear. Its essential nature is יִרְאָה at its elevated form — יִרְאַת הָרוֹמְמוּת (fear of exaltedness). The teaching equates it with this higher fear via נִקְרָא. When אֱמֶת (truth) joins צֶדֶק, the result is called אֱמוּנָה (per the Zohar passage). It belongs to the same fear-and-faith domain.
